subject: geom_smooth Ignores User Parameters for rlm

messages.author: 7b36a5521b8eb4d4
messages.subject: geom_smooth Ignores User Parameters for rlm
parts:
The constructor works fine :

> library(MASS)
> geom_smooth(method = rlm, maxit = 50, se = FALSE, colour = "red", alpha = 0.5, size = 2)
geom_smooth: colour = red, size = 2, alpha = 0.5
stat_smooth: method = function (x, ...)
UseMethod("rlm"), maxit = 50, se = FALSE
position_identity: (width = NULL, height = NULL)

But, the parameter maxit is not used :

> qplot(data[1, ], data[2, ]) + geom_smooth(method = rlm, maxit = 50, se = FALSE, colour = "red", alpha = 0.5, size = 2)
Warning message:
In rlm.default(x, y, weights, method = method, wt.method = wt.method,  :
  'rlm' failed to converge in 20 steps

It's using the default of 20 steps, rather than the provided value of 50. Is it a bug ?
